exposure: Natural pregnancy vs. in vitro fertilization (IVF)
Ultrasound-guided high-intensity focused ultrasound (USgHIFU) ablation for uterine fibroids
cohort: 560 reproductive-age women with symptomatic uterine fibroids who underwent USgHIFU therapy
finding: Patients undergoing USgHIFU treatment of uterine fibroids can achieve full-term pregnancies with few intrapartum or postpartum complications.
mod_finding: Of the 44 live births, 25 (57%) were born vaginally and 19 (43%) by cesarean section.
